limit: Signing in from another device takes https on a name of one's own; plain http signs in on the machine itself alone
note: ADR-0008's profiles for a home network are accepted and cannot sign in, as its own status says

limit: Every install is a Kubernetes cluster; the one-container install runs one of its own in a privileged container
says: docs/self-hosting#A. One-command appliance ; docs/self-hosting#D. k3s and Compose profiles ; docs/adr/0006-operator-owned-runtime
note: The profiles without a cluster of one's own, a script and Compose, are not supported today

limit: Every image is built for amd64 alone
Titles are encoded on an NVIDIA GPU or on the CPU, before they play and while they do
A plain install runs a database server, a cache, an event broker and an identity provider beside its own services, one of each
note: The documentation names no smallest machine

limit: By default the event broker keeps its log on a volume that goes with its pod: a restart loses topics and offsets
says: docs/prerequisites#Storage ; docs/self-hosting#3. Enable the media pipeline and GPU (optional)
note: Producers and the pipeline retry; a claim of one's own keeps the log

limit: Storage, certificates, backups, databases, the encoder and identity are set in the cluster's resource alone
capabilities: configure-storage ; provide-certificates ; schedule-backups ; restore-backup ; choose-databases ; choose-encoder ; choose-identity
note: The portal and the CLI offer updates, the pipeline's switch, scaling and restarts

limit: The product never updates its operator: a cluster admin applies each new one, and the one-container install is replaced
says: docs/updating-the-operator#Why the product will not do it for you ; docs/updating-the-operator#3. The appliance

limit: One operator renders every install of a cluster from the chart it embeds: a new operator changes them all at once
The one-container install, started as documented first, loses the platform when its container is replaced
note: On a named volume under a fixed host name a new container finds its cluster again

limit: Backups are dumps of the bundled databases onto a claim; the library and an external database are left to their storage
note: The documentation of this repository does not describe backups

limit: The platform sends nothing to a person or an admin outside its apps: no mail, no push
note: An invite link is handed over by hand; a password is reset by an admin, in the identity provider's console

limit: The catalog scans one folder of one volume, when it is told to
Titles' details come from one outside service, with a key of the admin's own
Where originals are retired a title is its package alone: renditions in segments, stereo and HDR10, and deleting is final
note: Originals are kept unless an admin sets them to go once packaged

limit: The apps are for the web, Android and iOS phones and tablets, Android TV and Samsung TVs, none from a public store yet
components: chino-web ; chino-mobile ; chino-androidtv ; chino-tizen ; chino-tvos ; chino-webos ; chino-roku

limit: A title is sent to a Google Cast device or an AirPlay screen alone: the TV apps can't be reached from a phone or a computer
note: No app announces itself on the home network; the server keeps no list of the screens signed in, and the TV apps hold no connection to it
